purpose: per-use annual figures for the parcel world, each traced to task ids, row ids and arithmetic, or null with a declared reason; written by derive_twin_constants.py, never by hand

sources.root: the .git-worktrees directory that holds this worktree

tile.basis: grid.tile_ft 25 of parcel-five-acre.world.json, squared; 43560 sq ft per acre

hours_basis.declared: the only cited paddock labor, cattle-move, is 15 minutes a day per herd and does not grow with paddock area; it is carried once per use in hours_per_year_per_use

hours_per_use_basis.assumes: one herd, moved daily whatever the paddock area: the row times a move, not an acre, so the figure is charged once when any paddock exists; horse-herd-move cites the same row and the same 15 minutes

capex_basis.declared: no banked price for livestock fence per foot (row cap-prices-lives-null); the energizer and tank are one per herd, carried in capex_usd_per_use; the other match prices piglets
capex_basis.searched: /fence|polywire|\bposts?\b/ over the claims of 192 priced rows in 5 stores

capex_per_use_basis.assumes: the energizer is rated 150 acres, so one serves every paddock on the parcel; the task model pairs fence_energizer with paddock_fence in food-forest-clear-goats, orchard-graze-sheep and names stock_tank in pig-batch-water, a batch held in paddock_fence; one tank for one herd; up-front price only, because no row gives either item a service life (cap-prices-lives-null)

yield_basis.arithmetic: 4 ton/acre/year x 2000 lb/ton x 0.45359237 kg/lb x 625/43560 acre/tile = 52.0652 kg/tile/year
yield_basis.assumes: a US short ton (the source is a US SARE report; the engine's ton is 2000 lb); the quote says 'tons/acre' without 'dry matter' and the twin reads it as dry matter (binding quantity annual_herbage_growth; row syn-cow-strip-sqft)

paddock.mapping: a paddock is grazed grass: the twin's pasture simulation grazes a cow (declared cow_head, the leader cow) on grassland
paddock.notes: fence service life 20 years (cap-life-fence-visual, an NRCS practice lifespan, not a measured life) waits for a per-foot fence price

hours_basis.arithmetic: (hoop-house-ventilate 10 + hoop-house-crop-plant 3 + hoop-house-crop-harvest 40 + hoop-house-crop-prune 22.5) = 75.5 h per 96 x 20 ft house = 1920 sq ft; 75.5 / 1920 x 625 sq ft/tile = 24.5768 h/tile/year
hours_basis.assumes: labor scales with growing area, and one season a year (the twin's task_hours already takes hours_per_house_per_season as hours_per_year)

hours_per_use_basis.declared: hoop-house hours scale with the house's tiles; none is fixed per use

capex_basis.declared: no banked price for a hoop house (row cap-prices-lives-null); the priced rows that name one price a thermal screen or curtain, or name none, and service life is banked without a price
capex_basis.searched: /hoop ?house|high tunnel/ over the claims of 192 priced rows in 5 stores

capex_per_use_basis.declared: no banked price for a hoop house (row cap-prices-lives-null); the priced rows that name one price a thermal screen or curtain, or name none, and service life is banked without a price
capex_per_use_basis.searched: /hoop ?house|high tunnel/ over the claims of 192 priced rows in 5 stores

yield_basis.declared: the hoop house yields tomatoes, not forage dry matter (row synth-hoop-house-output carries marketable lb, outside this field)
